To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) the license information of jar archives can be extracted using a code-search based approach, and 2) the license information can be extracted with a high precision and recall.

1) we have developed a code-search approach to identify the license of a Java component, 2) our approach is able to identify the licenses of 95% of all the components in our dataset of 3,600 jar archives, and 3) the licenses of 1.6% of the components in this dataset are unknown.

• We have developed an automated method to extract the license of a jar archive from its bytecode, using a code-search technique, and that this method is able to extract the license from 95.5% of all analyzed jar archives.

a code-search approach is a viable alternative to existing approaches, as it can be easily automated and does not require access to the source code of the library.
